verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a self-service transfer for users moving from an existing CRM to audit and sync their data. Its multi-object import can bring in companies and deals plus activities like calls and meetings, with associations between them, and deduplication by email, domain and record ID supports clean loading. The docs don't show owner mapping or full timeline/history preservation. missing for 10: documented preservation of record owners, evidence that full activity/email history and timestamps survive migration, named source-CRM connectors, independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful migration.
